title: Project document envelope
summary: One persisted document.json carries timeline, Quanta, composition and storyboard sections. project.json is a separate Runtime governance descriptor. Missing product documents read as a deterministic default.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: default_document
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam.

invariants.text: Timeline, Quanta, composition and shotlist share one Project document; their own modules own their vocabularies.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Contract schema checking is available; replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: The envelope has deterministic defaults but ProjectRepository does not enforce this schema on arbitrary stored documents. Legacy or incomplete stored objects can be read unchanged.

shotlist.description: Storyboard owned by the tools area; see iface:storyboard.edit/v1.
